name_jp: センコーグループホールディングス
summary_en: 4,464,200 shares acquired on 2025-12-05 for ¥8.49B under board authorization of ¥8.5B. Acquisition exceeded distributable surplus limits under Companies Act and accounting rules. Third-party committee investigation completed 2026-06-01, identifying deficiencies in compartmentalization, inter-departmental coordination, director knowledge, and external expert consultation as root causes. Remediation proposals include formal process documentation, staff training, and strengthened compliance oversight.
summary_jp: 2025年12月5日に4,464,200株を¥84.99億で取得（¥85億上限）。会社法・計算規則の分配可能額規制を超過。第三者委員会調査完了。原因：分掌不明確、部門連携不足、役員知識不足、外部専門家未利用。対応：業務フロー規程化、研修実施、法令遵守体制強化。

name_jp: センコーグループホールディングス
summary_en: 4,464,200 shares acquired for ¥8,499M via ToSTNeT-3 on 2025-12-05. Acquisition exceeded distributable surplus by ¥2,923M (distributable surplus at execution: ¥5,576M). Third-party committee of external counsel established to investigate causation and remediation; no repayment demanded of shareholders. FY3/26 and FY3/27 dividend guidance unchanged.
summary_jp: 2025年12月5日のToSTNeT-3による4,464,200株（¥8,499百万円）の取得が分配可能額(¥5,576百万円)を¥2,923百万円超過。外部弁護士による第三者委員会を設置し原因調査・再発防止方針を検討。株主への返還請求なし。配当予想は変更なし。
